'''2013 Match Play Championship Day 1 SAN DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[SAN]] at [[2013 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

Name as written on the Day 1 sheet.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
